# Clip Studio TIPS

> > Community-driven tutorial platform for Clip Studio Paint covering digital illustration, animation, manga/webtoon creation, and software techniques.

TIPS is the official knowledge-sharing hub for Clip Studio Paint (CSP), featuring tutorials from both Celsys/ClipStudioOfficial and community creators like LizStaley, covering everything from beginner setup to advanced animation and illustration workflows. The platform serves digital artists working across illustration, manga, webtoons, and animation.

## Key Topics

- Clip Studio Paint (CSP)
- Digital illustration techniques
- Animation basics and timeline
- Brush settings and customization
- 3D models and Camera Hand Scanner
- WEBTOONS creation
- Character design and anatomy
- Layer management and workspace setup
- Line art techniques
- Color theory and lighting effects
- Manga and comic creation
- Beginner tutorials and getting started
- Auto actions and shortcuts
- Companion Mode (smartphone integration)
- Official tutorials by ClipStudioOfficial

## Getting Started with Clip Studio Paint

- [How to Use Clip Studio Paint](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/1249): Official getting started guide: installation, trial & pen tablet setup
- [Clip Studio Paint computer version basics](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/1248): Official CSP computer basics: interface, tools & workspace setup
- [Basic Canvas Operations and Shortcuts](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/541): Official guide to canvas navigation, zoom, rotate & shortcuts
- [CLIP STUDIO PAINT Official Tutorials](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/official): Official tutorials for Clip Studio Paint covering basics to advanced
- [Customizing the User Interface](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/5114): UI customization guide for workspace & palettes by LizStaley
- [Where To Find the Best Clip Studio Tutorials](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/11264): Guide by LizStaley on locating CSP tutorials across platforms

## Digital Illustration Fundamentals

- [Guide to the Essential Digital Painting Tutorials Series](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/1879): Official essential digital painting tutorial series for CSP beginners
- [Tips for Flawless Line Art in Clip Studio Paint](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/8847): Beginner guide to digital line art techniques & brush settings by selunar
- [Clip Studio BRUSHES - Complete Ultimate Guide](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/6384): Complete guide to creating & customizing brushes by ManuMercurial
- [Process for Creating an Illustration: Advanced Guide](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/547): Official advanced illustration workflow guide by Taira Akitsu/CELSYS
- [Most Useful CSP Tools](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/8875): LizStaley's guide to essential CSP tools: layer color, auto actions & more

## Animation in Clip Studio Paint

- [The Basics of Animating in CSP](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/4934): Timeline, keyframes & tweening basics for CSP animation by Kantella
- [Animation Overview: Basics of Animating in Clip Studio Paint](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/7690): Animation fundamentals covering cels, frames & timeline by MsRedNebula
- [Easy Animation on clip studio for beginners](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/9247): Beginner animation tutorial for Clip Studio Paint by Lunamoon0

## Character Design and Anatomy

- [Step by Step - Draw and Render on Clip Studio Paint series](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/series/1876): Tutorial series by AriAraci on drawing & rendering hands in CSP
- [HOW TO GO ABOUT SIDE PROFILES](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/11988): Tutorial on drawing side profile anatomy & proportions by Adöva_rt
- [Step by Step Chibi Basic Guide](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/10580): Beginner guide to chibi character proportions & features by Zall
- [BEGINNER GUIDE TO 3D MODELS IN CLIP STUDIO](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/6949): Beginner tutorial on using 3D models & controls in CSP by Cyfuko
- [Using the New Camera Hand Scanner](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/7740): Tutorial on CSP 2.0 Camera Hand Scanner for 3D hand posing by LizStaley

## Manga and Webtoon Creation

- [Tips & Tricks for WEBTOONS series](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/series/2022): Tutorial series by sunnysora on creating WEBTOONS efficiently
